blockers: The 8-direction render is fundamentally broken: W and E show the character lying horizontally, while N, NW, and NE collapse into feet, weapon, or near-empty slivers. This is a camera/model-axis projection failure, not a locomotion problem that can be solved with minor frame polish.
The front silhouette is a generic rigid mannequin: symmetrical hanging arms, parallel legs, circular head, and no distinctive shoulder, waist, coat, hair, or rapier contour.
Native 1x readability is inadequate. Navy garments merge into the dark checkerboard, the corset and limbs collapse into low-value masses, and the rapier is mostly a thin incidental line.
The head reads as a featureless white oval with tiny noisy facial marks and no convincing hair volume or stylized facial planes, producing a mannequin-like uncanny result.
The idle strip is effectively static. There is no readable restrained breathing, balance adjustment, hand relaxation, cloth response, or weapon micro-motion.
The signature gesture strip does not establish a clean action arc. The repeated diagonal body pose lacks clear anticipation, primary rapier action, overshoot, settle, and visible weight transfer.
Locomotion frames do not show a usable contact/pass/flight rhythm, hip and shoulder counter-rotation, or directional personality. Most directions cannot be evaluated as standing walk cycles at all.
high_value_changes: Correct the direction transform and render camera basis so the character's local vertical axis remains screen-vertical in all eight views. Re-render the entire locomotion set before making animation refinements.

Redesign the front silhouette around a stronger Celina-specific contour: readable high collar, separated corset waist, shaped coat or skirt masses, asymmetrical rapier placement, visible hair profile, and non-parallel leg spacing.

Rebuild the native 1x palette hierarchy. Separate hair, skin, navy cloth, obsidian sections, boots, brass, and weapon with deliberate value steps that remain legible on both dark and light backgrounds.
Replace the white oval head with a compact stylized face, readable hair mass, controlled shadow plane, and a small but intentional eye/mouth arrangement that survives at the actual sprite scale.

Construct locomotion from explicit planted-foot, passing, lift, and recovery poses with minimal but visible hip/shoulder counter-rotation. Keep the feet locked to the anchor while allowing upper-body restraint and rapier balance to carry personality.
Redesign the signature gesture as a readable restrained rapier action: compressed anticipation, directional thrust or draw, controlled overshoot, weapon follow-through, and a distinct settle pose.
Add secondary motion that supports containment rather than noise: slight coat or collar response, brass glints, hair settling, and a measured sword-hand correction.
optional_notes: The measured 116px standing height and 0px ground-anchor drift satisfy the stated technical limits, but technical compliance does not compensate for the invalid directional renders.
The front-facing view is the only consistently inspectable locomotion direction in the supplied grid.
No prior iteration was supplied, so visual regressions cannot be established.
strongest_improvements: Standing height is within the 128px limit.
Ground anchor drift is reported at 0.0px.
The front view establishes a basic navy, white, and brass material hierarchy, although it is not sufficiently robust against dark backgrounds.
luna_evaluation.single_most_important_next_change: Fix the eight-direction camera/model coordinate transform and re-render every direction as an upright, standing character before revising silhouette or animation timing.
